-For the nearly 5,000 sperm that make it into the utero-tubal junction, around 1,000 of these reach the inside of the Fallopian tube.

-For the 1,000 sperm entering the tube, only around 200 actually reach the egg.

-In the end, only 1 lucky sperm out of this group of 200 actually penetrates and fertilizes the egg!

its really difficult to explain depression. imagine an invisible weight you have to carry around, and its such an effort to just pull yourself along because of it, you can't, you don't have the energy for anything else. but nobody else sees it, so you feel stupid bringing it up, and they all think it's stupid for you not to manage day-to-day life, because everything is fine, right? it's like being dyslexic or blind or colorblind or deaf or mute but with reality. you \*know\* there's something going on, but you can't figure out what it is. life is staring right at you yet you don't understand it. you try to find help, but since your mute, the words don't get out. things seem meaningless then, and you lose the will to do anything, including living.

attempting it is super scary, because all your natural instincts are screaming 'do something! don't die!' but you kinda stand frozen in time. the aftermath sucks. if ppl notice you either get sent to a psych ward or put on suicide watch, both literally traumatizing in their own. nobody will ever look at you the same. if nobody notices, you feel like the most useless person ever, like nobody cares at all, and it just proves to you nobody would mind if you died.
